verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own pricing page claims 'Freedom to self-host your data', and 2FAS Pass lets you store the vault in your own cloud or as an encrypted file, with a community report of WebDAV backup support. However, there is no documented self-hostable sync server, deployment guide, or perimeter-only architecture. The documented sync paths are iCloud and Google Drive. missing for 10: a documented self-hosted sync server component, deployment/installation docs, first-party WebDAV/self-hosted sync configuration docs, coverage for 2FAS Auth (not just Pass), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter

citations.quote: You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
